Calculate age groups at diagnosis and currently

Source: R/calc-basic.R
calc_age_groups.Rd

Calculate age groups at diagnosis and currently

Usage

calc_age_groups(df, cur_age_as_of = as.Date(getOption("kcHARS.ehars_dt")))

Arguments

df

A data.frame containing (at least) eHARS variables hiv_aids_age_yrs and dob

cur_age_as_of

A Date value specifying the date as of which to calculate each person's "current" age. Defaults to the date associated with the eHARS data being used.

Value

Input data frame df with the addition of variables hiv_aids_age_group and cur_age_group

Examples

read_ehars_person(col_select = c(dob, hiv_aids_age_yrs)) |> calc_age_groups() |> View()
#> Error: '//kc/dph/prevention/hiv/Epi/EXTRA SPACE/eHARS/Full eHARS/Archive/NA/person_sas7bdat/person.sas7bdat' does not exist.
